description: Three scripted Mac clients show one board. Ordinary calls go to the client whose user focused the board last, else the one focused most recently, else the one attached last. A client that misses its deadline or hangs up mid-call fails the call unavailable, naming it, and nothing is retried on another client. Browser object.reload does not use that order: it goes only to the tile's persisted drawingMachine. This records easld's protocol with scripted clients.
